caption: Sample 0.1 is nearer level 0 than level 1/3, so it is stored as code 0. The error row gives e = x − Q(x); the four squared errors average to MSE = 0.00639.

spec.title: Sampling and 2-bit quantization
spec.aria: Four samples 0.1, 0.4, 0.7 and 0.9 at t = 0, 1, 2, 3 s are mapped to levels 0, 1/3, 2/3 and 1 with codes 0 to 3; errors are 0.1, 1/15, 1/30 and −0.1.
